question: P and Q together can complete a work in 10 days. Q and R together can complete the same work in 15 days. R and P together can do it in 30 days. In how many days can Q alone complete the job?
solution:
**Given:**

P and Q together can complete the work in 10 days.

Q and R together can complete the work in 15 days.

R and P together can complete the work in 30 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done in 1 day = 1 / Total days required to complete the work.

LCM method to find total work.

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 10, 15, and 30.

⇒ LCM(10, 15, 30) = 30 u
